posts.tagline: Voice-activated teleprompter that tracks your speech
posts.description: A private, smart teleprompter, built by the chic artist, that automatically scrolls as you talk. It listens to your voice in real-time—if you pause, it pauses. Built with 100% on-device processing so your scripts and videos stay completely private. Features hands-free voice commands to start/stop recordings and an integrated video editor. Say goodbye to monthly subscriptions and enjoy full features with a single, lifetime unlock.

posts.name: Prospex
posts.tagline: The Swiss data platform for B2B prospecting
posts.description: Prospex helps Swiss B2B sales teams build a list of the companies worth their time, and keep it accurate as those companies change. Prospex then watches that list, and tells you the week a company on it is worth calling.

posts.name: Awkward Client Emails
posts.tagline: Stop freezing on awkward client emails — copy, tweak, send.
posts.description: Awkward Client Emails is a PDF toolkit of 30 copy-paste email scripts for freelancers, coaches, healers, and solopreneurs. Clear British English for overdue invoices, scope creep, revisions, boundaries, saying no and difficult conversations. Six categories; each script has a when-to-use note, subject line and body copy with [BRACKET] placeholders. Instant PDF download. Launch price £5 (normally £9); use code LAUNCH. Free 3-script sample available.

posts.name: Cute Bunny GO!
posts.tagline: Jump, dodge and chase your highest score with a cute bunny!
posts.description: Cute Bunny GO! is a fast-paced casual arcade game built for quick and addictive runs. Jump through challenging obstacles, collect strawberries and useful power-ups, and keep pushing for a higher score. Easy to learn, increasingly challenging, and made for players who enjoy simple but competitive mobile games.

posts.name: LOVE TESTER
posts.tagline: Free Online Love Calculator & Compatibility Test
posts.description: Use our free Love Tester to calculate love compatibility by name. Enter two names, get an instant love percentage, and share your result. Just for fun!

posts.name: India Terminal
posts.tagline: Institutional Grade AI Powered Stock Market Research Tool
posts.description: India's AI-powered fundamental research platform. Search 1500+ NSE stocks in plain Hindi or English — 'zero debt pharma companies' or 'karz mukt pharma companies'. Macro portfolio stress test, stock scorecards, AI fair value, earnings analysis, FII/DII flow, NSE filings with AI summaries. Screener.in alternative. Tickertape alternative. Free dashboard forever.

posts.name: Record it rough. Ship it studio.
posts.tagline: Studio narration for your demos, without re-recording
posts.description: Good demo voiceovers are painful, stumbles, restarts, re-recording the same minute over and over. dub.house rewrites your rough narration into a clean, professional script and generates a new voiceover synced to your screen. Or just tell it what to say. It only replaces the audio, no video edits, no lip-sync, no voice cloning. Free tier to try.

posts.name: Nugget — Become a better friend
posts.tagline: Helps you remember the small things that matter
posts.description: Nugget helps you remember the small things that matter about the people in your life. Short notes, follow-ups, and a Home Screen widget — all on your iPhone.

posts.name: FFTrans HUD
posts.tagline: Offline real-time transcription and translation HUD
posts.description: Fully offline real-time transcription & translation HUD for Mac. Capture microphone, system audio, or app audio and display results instantly on screen.

posts.name: Kairo App
posts.tagline: Private memories that grow with the people you love
posts.description: Kairo creates private memory timelines with the people who matter most. It quietly recognizes time spent together, so your story grows without constant manual logging. Add photos, short clips, notes, and optional location context, then revisit everything through monthly Memory Books. Memories stay on your phone by default, with optional encrypted backup. Kairo remembers the time. You give it meaning.

posts.name: Lingbot Video
posts.tagline: multi-model AI studio for video and image generation
posts.description: Lingbot Video is an AI creation and discovery platform: create AI images free after sign-up, track the latest AI video models, and read independent guides.

posts.name: JJ-JobHunter
posts.tagline: AI job search automation, built around your real experience
posts.description: Apply to jobs 10x faster with AI. JJ-JobHunter generates tailored CVs, cover letters and emails for every job application automatically.

posts.name: PRUDVIA
posts.tagline: AI intelligence for construction projects and portfolios
posts.description: PRUDVIA is an AI-powered project & portfolio intelligence platform built for construction and real estate teams. It brings project progress, financial performance, risks, challenges and executive reporting into one place. Its AI Project Assistant analyzes project information, while the AI Decision Support Center turns approved performance data into predictive insights, early warnings and actionable executive decisions.

posts.name: wifibox
posts.tagline: Zero-install, zero-signup instant P2P file & link sharing
posts.description: wifibox lets you share files, photos, links, and text across iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows with zero app installs, zero accounts, and zero tracking. Built with WebRTC P2P technology, your files transfer directly between devices without consuming cloud storage or leaving caches on chat apps. Devices on the same Wi-Fi connect instantly, and a private room link allows secure sharing across different networks. It also features both a shared group board and direct 1:1 transfers.

posts.name: CVBranch
posts.tagline: Evidence-based resume tailoring for IT job applications
posts.description: CVBranch is an AI resume tailor for software and IT—not a general resume builder for every industry. Upload your CV, paste a job description, see required vs preferred skill gaps, answer evidence-based gap questions, then compose a one-page resume for that role. Matching is deterministic; AI drafts only from your facts—no invented stack, metrics, or seniority. Built for engineering, DevOps, data, and similar roles that need JD fit without keyword fiction.

posts.name: Shift Path Work Calendar
posts.tagline: Flexible rotating-shift calendar for iPhone
posts.description: Build any repeating shift rotation, adjust individual days or full blocks, and clearly track overtime, double time, time away, lieu days, and black days. Shift Path also provides pay-period reports, Excel exports, and one-way Apple Calendar sync for sharing schedules—all without requiring an account or tracking users.

posts.name: Khetiyaar
posts.tagline: From Soil to Sale
posts.description: Free AI farming app for India: crop plans, photo-based disease diagnosis, hyperlocal weather, mandi rates and an Agri Bazar of verified dealers — in…

posts.name: PRAETOR CV
posts.tagline: Free AI tool to test your CV against any job description
posts.description: PRAETOR is a free, open-source system prompt that helps you evaluate how well your own CV matches a job description. Unlike typical resume tools, it is designed strictly for personal self-assessment (not hiring). It prioritizes privacy (forces PII redaction), applies anti-bias logic for career gaps, and uses a transparent scoring system. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other LLMs.

posts.name: Chores Nest: Family Organizer
